snippet.title: Hot Pig Jump! Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
A pig is the only living thing in a world where a strange god is slowly killing off all life.  This pig is determined to fight back against its divine oppressor because it is lonely and angry.  The souls of the creatures that are gone now give their last bit of strength to make a way for the pig to fight god itself.

 You control the determined pig as it goes up and down in this 3D action game.  Your mission is to climb up to the sky while avoiding obstacles and flamethrowers that could kill you.

 Minimum System Requirements

 Windows 10 (64-bit) is the operating system.

 Intel i7-4790 is the processor.

 16 GB of RAM in memory

 NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 for graphics

 Storage: 3 GB of free space This video contains gameplay footage of the game mentioned in the title. 
The gameplay is recorded and shared for commentary, review, and educational purposes. 
All rights to the game and its content belong to the respective copyright holders. 
Music and sound effects that may trigger Content ID have been removed or replaced where possible.
